import re

def slugify(title: str, max_len: int = 50) -> str:
    """Builds a URL slug."""
    title = title.lower()
    title = re.sub(r"[^\w\s-]", "", title)
    title = re.sub(r"[-\s]+", "-", title)
    title = title.strip("-")
    if len(title) > max_len:
        parts = title.split("-")
        new_title = ""
        for part in parts:
            if len(new_title) + len(part) + 1 <= max_len:
                new_title += part + "-"
            else:
                break
        new_title = new_title.rstrip("-")
        return new_title
    else:
        return title

from collections import defaultdict
import re
import math

def top_customers(rows: list[dict], n: int) -> list[tuple[str, float]]:
    """
    Calculates the total amount spent by each customer and returns the top n customers.
    """
    customer_totals = defaultdict(float)
    for row in rows:
        name = row.get("customer", "").strip()
        amount_str = row.get("amount", "")
        if not name or not amount_str:
            continue
        try:
            amount = float(re.sub(r'[$,]', '', amount_str))
            if amount < 0:
                amount = -amount
            customer_totals[name.lower()] += amount
        except ValueError:
            continue
    
    sorted_customers = sorted(customer_totals.items(), key=lambda item: (-item[1], item[0]))
    
    return sorted_customers[:n]
